title: Colony PCR on V. natriegens
author: Daniel Bauersachs
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.pundnve

steps.title: Prepare PCR master mix
steps.instruction: In a PCR tube combine 5 μl reaction buffer, 0.5 μl dNTP mix, 0.5 μl forward primer, 0.5 μl reverse primer, 0.1 μl One‑Taq DNA polymerase, and 18.4 μl A.dest. (distilled water) to a final volume of 25 μl. Mix gently.

steps.title: Add colony and start PCR
steps.instruction: Using a sterile pipette tip, pick a single V. natriegens colony and dip the tip into the 25 μl reaction mix for about 15 seconds, then remove the tip. Immediately place the tube in the thermocycler and run the PCR program.
